title: Drop Us A Line - How Do We Think It's Been?
content:
We've got a live one!

At the London Podcast Festival, Dan, James, Andy and Anna sift through the correspondence sent in by listeners.

Visit nosuchthingasafish.com for news about live shows, merchandise and more episodes.

If you'd like to write in, you can email podcast@qi.com

Edited by Leying Lee, Joe Mayo and Dan Schreiber

Team includes Tara Dorrell, Ethan Ruparelia and Delilah Walter
